BeatBoxFinal（二）：启动与 GUI

Final BeatBox client program · 《Head First Java》p675
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    new BeatBoxFinal().startUp(args[0]);
  }

  public void startUp(String name) {
    userName = name;
    // open connection to the server
    try {
      Socket socket = new Socket("127.0.0.1", 4242);
      out = new ObjectOutputStream(socket.getOutputStream());
      in = new ObjectInputStream(socket.getInputStream());
      ExecutorService executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
      executor.submit(new RemoteReader());
    } catch (Exception ex) {
      System.out.println("Couldn't connect-you'll have to play alone.");
    }
    setUpMidi();
    buildGUI();
  }

  public void buildGUI() {
    JFrame frame = new JFrame("Cyber BeatBox");
    frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
    BorderLayout layout = new BorderLayout();
    JPanel background = new JPanel(layout);
    background.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(10, 10, 10, 10));

    Box buttonBox = new Box(BoxLayout.Y_AXIS);

    JButton start = new JButton("Start");
    start.addActionListener(e -> buildTrackAndStart());
    buttonBox.add(start);

    JButton stop = new JButton("Stop");
    stop.addActionListener(e -> sequencer.stop());
    buttonBox.add(stop);

    JButton upTempo = new JButton("Tempo Up");
    upTempo.addActionListener(e -> changeTempo(1.03f));
    buttonBox.add(upTempo);

    JButton downTempo = new JButton("Tempo Down");
    downTempo.addActionListener(e -> changeTempo(0.97f));
    buttonBox.add(downTempo);

    JButton sendIt = new JButton("sendIt");
    sendIt.addActionListener(e -> sendMessageAndTracks());
    buttonBox.add(sendIt);

    userMessage = new JTextArea();
    userMessage.setLineWrap(true);
    userMessage.setWrapStyleWord(true);
    JScrollPane messageScroller = new JScrollPane(userMessage);
    buttonBox.add(messageScroller);
args[0]命令行参数就是你的屏幕名。例：% java BeatBoxFinal theFlash
Socket + Object 流这里用 Socket 而不是 Channel，因为它和 Object 输入/输出流配合更好
executor.submit(...)启动读线程（RemoteReader），专门盯服务器来信
createEmptyBorder给面板四边留出边距——纯装饰
e -> buildTrackAndStart()lambda 表达式：按钮被按下时调用本类的某个方法
changeTempo(1.03f)默认速度是 1.0，每点一次调 ±3%
sendIt新增：把消息和当前节拍序列发给音乐服务器
